## Functional assignment

The 308-residue protein is **2-methylisocitrate lyase** (**EC 4.1.3.30**), an enzyme of the **methylcitrate cycle** involved in propionate and other short-chain fatty-acid catabolism.

The sequence is an **exact match** to the reviewed UniProt protein **Q9YFM7**, providing very strong support for this assignment.

## Catalytic reaction

\[
\text{(2R,3S)-2-methylisocitrate}
\longrightarrow
\text{pyruvate}+\text{succinate}
\]

This is a **Mg²⁺-dependent C–C bond cleavage** reaction. It is a lyase reaction rather than an oxidation–reduction reaction. The reaction proceeds through an **α-carboxy-carbanion intermediate**.

## Additional features

- **Cofactor:** Mg²⁺  
- **Pathway:** Methylcitrate cycle / propionate degradation  
- **Likely oligomeric state:** Homotetramer, according to the matched reference annotation  
- **Evidence level:** Curated annotation supported by an exact full-length sequence match, not merely a weak homology-based inference.
